observations.publisher: Government of Estonia, Prime Minister's Office
observations.summary: Estonian government says a November 14 attempted sabotage against drone manufacturer Threod Systems was thwarted and attributes it to Russian intelligence. On November 15 Prime Minister Kristen Michal instructed officials to prepare possible closure of the Russia border. The closure had not yet been implemented as of this observation; Russian responsibility is an Estonian official attribution, not independently established here.
observations.title: Estonian prime minister orders preparation for potential Russia border closure after attempted sabotage
